title: How 50,000 Migrants Surged Into Ceuta, a Spanish Exclave Near Morocco
summary: On Thursday, tens of thousands of Moroccans broke into Ceuta, a Spanish territory that neighbors Morocco. By Friday evening, most of them had left, hungry and disappointed.
